what: The JOC downmix configuration of every Dolby track in the library, not just the first per file
method: ten seconds off the front of every eac3 or ac3 track of every file, read with `oadec info --json`. The configuration is a header field and is constant within a stream in every scan taken, so a head clip answers this one question -- it does not answer the per-frame syntax questions, which is what `joc_coverage.py` reads whole files for. tools/joc_config_sweep.py
why_it_differs_from_the_earlier_sweep: the earlier library sweep read one Dolby track per file and reported 112 of 113 at configuration 3 with one at 0. Five of these discs carry a second Dolby track at configuration 4, and stopping at the first misses every one of them.
